caption: The drawing consists of several objects rendered in pencil or graphite on a light beige background. The central and largest object is a detailed lidded tankard or mug with a textured handle that has a small decorative lion's head at its lower end. The tankard is cylindrical with a domed lid featuring a thumb rest and subtle decorative elements along its edge and near its base. Above the large tankard, the composition displays a coat of arms with a lion rampant at its center, surrounded by elaborate scrollwork. Flanking the coat of arms are two smaller tankard sketches: one on the left in profile with a single handle, and one on the right presented frontally showing a cylindrical shape with a symmetrical lid. At the top, handwritten text reads: "A Legacy Of Mr Jeremiah Own to the Presbyterian Church in New York 1756." The artist's signature, "Elayton Brown," appears near the bottom right corner. The drawing employs various shading techniques for depth and dimension, and all elements are in grayscale, without any use of color except the natural off-white of the paper.
title: Silver Tankard
